audit.whatIsWrong: All seven rows disagreed with the packet chart, and six of them disagreed with the page's own content captions.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and the mirror both read Renekton / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Skill. whys[1] through whys[5] already describe Maokai taking each of those stages (root online, root chaining, the sustain grind, Nature's Grasp, Heartsteel) and whys[6] calls two items a stalemate — only the side tokens were inverted.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set in matched full/content pairs with ratings adjusted, and the six full-layer whys that still described a Renekton lane rewritten to the real reason for each side.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Twisted Advance a 'lock-on root' to dodge, and never mentions that Maokai is untargetable for the whole of it.
audit.why: Riot's text: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, BECOMING UNTARGETABLE and dashing to the target, rooting on arrival. That inverts the advice — it is not something you dodge, it is something that eats whatever you spend into it, so the counterplay is to hold your burst until he lands rather than to sidestep. It is 14/13/12/11/10s, so 'short cooldown' is 14s at rank 1 dropping to 10s. Sap Magic heals him on the empowered attack and its cooldown shortens every time he casts a spell or is hit by one, which is why Grievous Wounds decides the grind. Sapling Toss reaches 1100 and is stronger in brush on an 18s rank-1 cooldown; Nature's Grasp is a 3000-range advancing root on 130/110/90.
audit.corrected: The untargetability written into whys[1], spikes[1].text, wants.foe[0], dosFull[0].d and phases[1].why; the real cooldowns into whys[3], phases[3].why, phases[4].why, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d.

notes:
The advice on Twisted Advance was inverted: the page told the player to dodge a 'lock-on root', but Riot's text says Maokai becomes UNTARGETABLE while dashing to the target. You cannot dodge a targeted dash and you cannot damage him during it, so the correct play is to hold the burst until he lands rather than spend it into the approach. Three suspectNames hits ('Twisted Advance') are all false positives — the name is correct.

Not asserted, matching the mirror: Bramble Smash (Q) carries a 'grounding' derived flag, but Riot's description gives only a knockback and a slow, so no claim about Slice and Dice being denied was written anywhere.
